info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Consumer Investment Details API
info.description: This API enables financial institutions to update specific details of consumer investments efficiently. By leveraging the PATCH method, users can modify attributes of existing investment accounts, such as investment goals, risk tolerances, and preferred investment strategies. This endpoint is particularly useful for account managers and financial advisors who need to personalize investment profiles based on client feedback or changing market conditions. Enhancing the consumer investment experience helps drive customer satisfaction and engagement.
